nodes.summary: `x` and `y` are joined by a path of open edges of `ω` in `G` (`x ↔ y`).
nodes.title: Open connection between two vertices

nodes.summary: Colorings constant on open clusters with `σ x = σ y` correspond to colorings of the clusters that agree on the clusters of `x` and `y`.
nodes.title: Correspondence for cluster-constant colorings equal at two vertices

nodes.summary: For `a ≠ b`, functions `C → Fin q` with `f a = f b` correspond to functions on `C \ {b}`.
nodes.title: Functions equal at two points as functions omitting one point

nodes.summary: The Ising two-point function equals the random-cluster connection probability with `q = 2`: `⟨σ_x σ_y⟩ = φ_{p,2}(x ↔ y)` (Edwards–Sokal 1988; Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*, 2006, Theorem 1.16).
nodes.title: Ising two-point function equals the $q = 2$ connection probability

nodes.summary: The Ising two-point function `⟨σ_x σ_y⟩` at bond parameter `p`, computed as the Edwards–Sokal spin marginal.
nodes.title: Ising two-point function from the Edwards–Sokal coupling

nodes.summary: The Ising spin value of a two-state color: `0 ↦ -1`, `1 ↦ 1`.
nodes.title: Ising spin value of a two-state color

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
